name: Valeren — 3 Advanced — Blessing of the Name

system.description:
The Salubri calls upon the angel whose name she bears, opening her third eye to shed a harsh golden light that strips away grime and injury from view and casts her as an avenging member of the Lord's hosts — a sight that inspires allies and strikes terror into foes. Witnesses never agree on exactly what they saw.

System: The Salubri invokes the angel's name and states her purpose. The player rolls the character's Path rating (difficulty 8); two successes are needed to activate the power. For the remainder of the scene the Salubri is treated as having Presence ••••• and ignores all wound penalties. Foes must succeed at a Willpower roll to attempt to strike her at all, and even then suffer +2 difficulty to hit; the Storyteller may grant sufficiently inspired allies -2 difficulty to strike their foes. When the scene ends, all the effect concealed (injuries, filth, etc.) returns, often more pronounced, and the character is ravenously hungry unless already Incapacitated or in torpor. A character may invoke this power only once per story, and using it for anything other than genuine life-threatening danger or altruistic purpose risks angering the Heavenly Host, who may withdraw their protection at an inconvenient moment.

This is a power of the ritual of the blooding, available only to warriors who have undergone an accurate blooding per the Code of Samiel. It may be purchased for 7 experience points by those who qualify.
system.source: Clanbook: Salubri (Dark Ages), Chapter Four: The Powers of the Righteous
system.prerequisites: Blooding by the Code of Samiel
